title: Supervised Fine-Tuning with LoRA, Step by Step
summary: Build a real SFT run end to end with Hugging Face TRL and PEFT: prepare a conversational dataset, configure LoRA or QLoRA, train with SFTTrainer on a CPU or a free Colab T4, read the loss curves, score the tuned model against the base on held-out data, then save, merge and share the adapter.
objectives: Turn a public dataset into a clean, deduplicated conversational SFT set and estimate its training cost from token statistics
Configure LoraConfig, BitsAndBytesConfig and SFTConfig for CPU, T4 or Ampere hardware, and verify the loss mask before training
Compute steps per epoch and total steps, and diagnose overfitting, a too-high learning rate and NaNs from the training log
Judge a tuned model against its base on a held-out set with format, exact-match and execution accuracy, plus a forgetting check
Save, load, merge and share a LoRA adapter, and predict its size on disk
prerequisites: The ideas behind every step are in [Instruction Tuning](/learn/fine-tuning/instruction-tuning) (chat templates, loss masking, packing) and [LoRA and QLoRA](/learn/fine-tuning/peft-lora). Size your run with [Start Here](/learn/fine-tuning/start-here), and set up your machine or notebook with [Run Fine-Tuning Yourself](/learn/fine-tuning/run-fine-tuning-yourself).
